story_info.title: Barnaby's Twinkling Star Wish
story_info.subtitle: A quiet evening in Wonderwood Valley.
story_info.moral: Taking deep breaths helps you feel calm and ready for sleep.

main_character.name: Barnaby Bunny
main_character.appearance: Barnaby is a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look.

cover.prompt: A Pixar-quality 3D illustration of Barnaby Bunny, a small, soft grey-and-white bunny with long floppy ears, round sleepy eyes, and a little pink nose. He has a plush, huggable, storybook-soft look. He is lying comfortably on soft grass in Moonlight Meadow, looking up at a night sky full of gently twinkling stars. The setting sun casts a warm, soft glow, with the first stars appearing.

slides.title: Evening in Moonlight Meadow
slides.text: Barnaby Bunny sat in Moonlight Meadow. The sun was going down. Pink and orange colours filled the sky. Soon, the first tiny stars twinkled. Barnaby's sleepy eyes looked up. He loved how the night began. He felt a soft, happy feeling inside.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby watches the sun set, feeling happy as stars start to appear.

slides.title: Many Twinkling Lights
slides.text: Darkness came. Many more stars popped out. The sky looked like a dark blanket. It had shiny, tiny lights. Barnaby wanted to see every single one. He found a cozy spot. It was under a big, friendly bush. He lay down on the soft grass.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby finds a cozy spot to watch the many stars.

slides.title: A Big, Starry Sky
slides.text: "So many stars!" Barnaby said softly. His eyes felt a little tired. He wanted to enjoy them all. But the sky was very, very big. He closed his eyes for a moment. He remembered a special trick. It helped him feel calm and quiet.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby feels a little overwhelmed by the vast sky and remembers a calming trick.

slides.title: Taking Calm Breaths
slides.text: Barnaby took a deep, slow breath. He held it, then let it out slowly. He did it again. In, and out. "One star at a time," he thought. He found a bright star. He watched it twinkle. Then he moved to the next one. He felt peace grow inside him.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby uses deep breaths to calm himself and focus on one star at a time.

slides.title: Sweet Dreams Begin
slides.text: Barnaby smiled. He felt warm and calm. The stars looked like little friends. They shone just for him. He gave a gentle yawn. "Sweet dreams begin with a smile!" he whispered. He closed his sleepy eyes, ready for a cozy night.
slides.speaker_notes: Barnaby feels peaceful and ready for sleep after enjoying the stars.
